transcript.text: Good morning, everyone. Thank you for being here. As you know, we have a preliminary-injunction hearing that could be requested within three weeks regarding the departure of our former sales executive to a direct competitor. We believe confidential customer information may have been used after the departure, and our draft filing currently seeks broad relief covering customer information, pricing materials, and source-code documentation. Under our pre-filing practice, I'm conducting this case conference now so that employment, forensics, and insurance counsel can each report any material issue before I make the filing decision. I need everyone to be candid about any concerns or prerequisites they see. Let's start — could employment, forensics, and insurance counsel each walk me through where things stand from your perspective?
